great-plains.vegetation: semi-arid temperate grassland, mixed and tallgrass prairie

eurasian-steppe.vegetation: temperate grass steppe, feathergrass and wormwood

pontic-caspian-steppe.vegetation: temperate steppe grassland, feather grass and spring wildflowers
pontic-caspian-steppe.term_origin: Pontic = Black Sea (Greek Pontus Euxinus); Caspian Sea

kazakh-steppe.vegetation: semi-arid dry steppe, feathergrass, wormwood and fescue
kazakh-steppe.term_origin: Named for Kazakhstan; world's largest dry steppe

north-china-plain.vegetation: fertile alluvial farmland, yellow-earth wheat and maize plain

indo-gangetic-plain.vegetation: fertile alluvial plain, monsoon rice and wheat farmland
indo-gangetic-plain.term_origin: Named for the Indus and Ganges river systems

llanos.vegetation: tropical savanna grassland, seasonally flooded plains

campos.vegetation: temperate/subtropical grassland, northern extension of the Pampas
